\caption{Selection geometry and training-time vs.\ deployment-time gate mediation. \textbf{(a)} Top-decile contests drive gamble share above $90\%$, while floor elimination collapses gambling below $5\%$. \textbf{(b)} Applying an exogenous gate only post-hoc at deployment blocks external harm but leaves covert shortcut intent intact (55.1\%) and wastes step budget (41.0\% task completion), whereas training policy gradients inside the gate redirects capacity into genuine task completion (85.9\%, $+44.8$\,pp). \textbf{(c)} Upper-tail contests reward variance ($\sigma$), whereas survival floors and concave capped objectives penalize it.}\label{fig:v3selection}\end{figure*}
